section.31: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

31.name_native: The Book of Manumission of Slaves

hadiths.text: Jabir b. 'Abd Allah said:A man declared that his slave would be free after his death, but he had no other property. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered (to sell him). He was then sold for seven hundred or nine hundred (dirhams)
